content: Gore surube enaali raayome gavman-na agale-para ali muduna agale-para pagoma pora raitalepape loma nimuna kone ma-redepo yaina agale mana laketapape. Go puma nimumi epe kogono raayo pala pirinalo waru laketapape.
Nimumi enaali meda madaa pa koe agale natapape lo laketapape. Go puma nimu pawa epe-rupa piruma epe konere ade abuna enaali raayo-para salepape lo laketapape.

Gore abalade page naame makeae kone suma agale yokoma koe-rupa pirisima. Go puma naamere kone koe rado rado wisima rabu naame koe elenu madaa lo robaa-para raaname kome kone wisimade. Go puma naame abalade alinu medaloma mada koe kone suma nimuna elenu madaa ade abuna kepaame komo pirisima. Go puma ali medalomame naa-para yada lore ali aulasimi rabu naame go koe kone abutalore nimu-para page yada lore ali aula pirisima.
Go pisima pare naa raba meape Gote-me naa-para epe kone su ranaame komisa.

Go puma nipumi naa ade abuna kagaa mapiraape kone gisa. Go pisare naame nipuna epe kogono pisima-daa namisa. Dia, pare nipumi naa kodome komoma naa ade abuna kagaa piramala popena pisa. Go pisa rabu nipuna Holi Spirit-na purimi naa kagaa nogo naaki-rupa mapiraasa.
Gore naana Raba Meape Ali Yesu Keriso-me kogono pisa-daare Gote-me Holi Spirit-na puri raayo naa madaa mea epenalisa.
Nipuna epe raba meape kone gisa rabu nipumi naa epe redepo le enaalinu mapiraasa. Go pumare naame mo ade abuna kagaa pirape epe kone muma abi page naame go kone madaa adoba piramina.
Go agalere ora agale ria yaade. Naa konemere go agale neme puri paloma lakelaina kone salo. Go puma enaalinu medalomame Gote madaa puri paloma kone rulalimiri gore nimi epe kogono palimina.

Go pea pare kuma napi agale-para nimi madi kasuana Yapi-para ape puma le agale-para rekena agale madaa ape le agaa-parare go raayore ora giyape. Gore naame adema rabu mo agalemere naa epe pora raitapena-daa naraba mea.
Gore ali medame Yesuna ruru enaalinu marugulalo palia-daare neme puri pale agale mana rana komea page rana laapo page laketapape. Go pali pare nena agale napagalimi-daare gore neme nimu giyape.
Gore neme makuaape go-rupa aliri nipuna koe eleme nipuna kone ora makoyaaya. Go puma nipumi koe ele pea rabu go koe eleme nipu koe ali pename waatea.
Gore werepe Artemas-para Tikikus laapo ne piri-para epenatoa-daare ne wagepu go Nikopolis su-para epape. Go su-parare koe upame komape yapi di-na go su-para epalia-le abi epape.
Neme go rekena agale tisaa ali Senas raba meape. Apolos page raba meape. Neme nipu pora pamina elenu page raba meape.

Go page neme naana enaali rurunuri ade abuna epe kogono paminalo mogeape. Go pumare enaali medaloma elenu ora dia yaaliare raba minalo laketapape. Go puma nimi pa kiaa kepele enaalinu napiraminalo laketapape.

Enaali raayo ni raapu komea-para pima enaalimiri epe-rupa piralepape lo agale wai lo rapaaema. Gore naana adami enaalinu piruma kone rulaemede enaalinuri epe-rupa piralepape lo laketapape. Gote-na epe raba meape kone nimi raayo raapu wina.
